sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 160 x 157 x 66 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Plan size 160 x 157 x 66 mm, 1.0 to 1.1 kg (dealer, B&H; the page returned HTTP 403 when re-opened today). No connector table was retrieved. A web search found only that the interface has two mic preamps and, per a Thomann description, four analogue line outs, an ADAT input and a headphone preamp: 5 ports are modelled as a stand-in with guessed positions (2 mic inputs, 2 monitor outs, 1 headphone out). Real unit has a sloped / rounded top and a large monitor knob; here a plain rounded box (rack-box) and the knob is picture only. portsDocumented stays false: the page gives connector types and counts but not which panel carries them; positions are guesses (the shape, not the layout, is what the build checks).
